library(ggside)

dnorm_shaded <- function(x, lod) {
  y <- dnorm(x, mean = 2, sd = 1)
  y[x > lod] <- NA  # Mask values greater than 2
  return(y)
}

dunif_shaded <- function(x,lod) {
  y <- dunif(x,min = 0, max = 4)
  y[x > lod] <- NA
  return(y)
}

dgamma_shaded <- function(x,lod) {
  y <- dgamma(x, shape = 2, scale = 1)
  y[x > lod] <- NA
  return(y)
}



library(ggplot2)
library(ggside)
library(dplyr)

# 1. Define the parameters and the Marker Lookup Table
lods <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
side_colors <- c("#9c179e","#ed7953")

# This table links the facet's LOD value to the specific marker for each distribution
marker_lookup <- data.frame(
  lod_vis = lods,
  m_norm  = qnorm(lods,0,1),
  m_unif  = qunif(lods,-3,3)
#   m_gamma = c(0.9612788, 1.678347, 2.692635)
)

# 2. Create the grid and join the marker values
z1 <- seq(-3, 3, length = 60)
z2 <- seq(-3, 3, length = 60)
locations <- 0 + c(-1, 0, 1)

grid_all <- expand.grid(Z1 = z1, Z2 = z2, loc_val = locations, lod_vis = lods) %>%
  mutate(
    # eta = .2 * (Z1 + Z2 + .5 * Z1 * Z2),
    # eta = Z1,
    # eta = (Z1+Z2)/2,
    # resp = plogis(eta, location = loc_val, scale = 0.5),
    # resp = plogis((Z1+Z2)/2, location = loc_val, scale = 0.5),
    resp = 0.5 * plogis(Z1, location = loc_val, scale = 1) + 0.5 * plogis(Z2, location = loc_val, scale = 1),
    loc_lab = paste("h Center:", loc_val),
    lod_lab = paste("LOD Quantile:", round(lod_vis, 2))
  ) %>%
  left_join(marker_lookup, by = "lod_vis") # Adds the specific markers to every row

# 3. Build the plot
ggplot(grid_all, aes(x = Z1, y = Z2, z = resp)) +
  geom_contour_filled(breaks = seq(0, 1, .025)) +
  
  # Reference lines in main plot (white)
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = m_norm), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[1]) + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = m_unif), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[2]) + 
#   geom_hline(aes(yintercept = m_gamma), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[3]) + 

  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = m_norm), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[1]) + 
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = m_unif), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[2]) + 
#   geom_vline(aes(xintercept = m_gamma), linetype = "dashed", color = side_colors[3]) + 
  
  
  facet_grid(lod_lab ~ loc_lab) +
  
  # --- Marginal Functions ---
  geom_xsidefunction(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = 0, sd = 1), color = side_colors[1], linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_xsidefunction(fun = dunif, args = list(min = -3, max = 3), color = side_colors[2], linewidth = 1) + 
#   geom_xsidefunction(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape = 2, scale = 1), color = side_colors[3], linewidth = 1) + 
  
  geom_ysidefunction(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = 0, sd = 1), color = side_colors[1], linewidth = 1) + 
  geom_ysidefunction(fun = dunif, args = list(min = -3, max = 3), color = side_colors[2], linewidth = 1) + 
#   geom_ysidefunction(fun = dgamma, args = list(shape = 2, scale = 1), color = side_colors[3], linewidth = 1) + 
  

  # --- Distribution Markers (Mapping to the joined columns) ---
  # These will now respect the facet because they are part of the main data mapping
  geom_xsidesegment(aes(x = m_norm, xend = m_norm, y = 0, yend = Inf), 
                    color = side_colors[1], linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_xsidesegment(aes(x = m_unif, xend = m_unif, y = 0, yend = Inf), 
                    color = side_colors[2], linetype = "dashed") +
#   geom_xsidesegment(aes(x = m_gamma, xend = m_gamma, y = 0, yend = Inf), 
#                     color = side_colors[3], linetype = "dashed") +

  geom_ysidesegment(aes(y = m_norm, yend = m_norm, x = 0, xend = Inf), 
                    color = side_colors[1], linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_ysidesegment(aes(y = m_unif, yend = m_unif, x = 0, xend = Inf), 
                    color = side_colors[2], linetype = "dashed") +
#   geom_ysidesegment(aes(y = m_gamma, yend = m_gamma, x = 0, xend = Inf), 
#                     color = side_colors[3], linetype = "dashed") +
  

  theme_minimal() + 
  theme_ggside_minimal() + 
  ggside(collapse = "y") + 
  theme(ggside.panel.scale.y = .05,
        ggside.panel.scale.x = .15,
        ggside.axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
        ggside.axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none")
